name: computer/find-files
title: Find files
summary: Find files by name, type, size or age and report them, largest or newest first.
when: Use when the user asks where a file is or which files are big, recent or of a type.
steps: Call workspace action show first so every later path is relative to the folder the user actually means.
Call glob_files with a pattern such as **/*.pdf and the path of the search folder.
Call grep_files with the word or regex plus glob when the search is by content rather than by file name.
Call run_command with find path -size +100M, or ls -lt for recent files, when the search is by size or age.
Call list_files on the folder when glob finds nothing, to catch hidden names and nested folders.
Sort the matches by size or date, largest or newest first, and count them so the total matches the list.
Call remote action run with the same find command when the folder is on another machine, not a guess.
Report each file with its full path, size and date, and say plainly when nothing matched the search.
next: The final answer must list the matching files with full path, size and date, sorted as asked, and give the total count or say nothing matched.
